note: Captured two reusable candidates from the story-005 review findings.

candidates.text: OAuth account-link flows must verify the returned state against stored initiation context before exchanging the code or binding tokens to a local user.
candidates.rationale: The story-005 review found that using an auth code without verified state allowed calendar tokens to be attached to the wrong user, which is a reusable security rule for any OAuth linking flow.

candidates.text: When a scheduling rule is intended for whole-day constraints, do not trigger it from a single-window event unless the implementation explicitly proves full-day coverage.
candidates.rationale: The review found that day-wide small-task filtering was incorrectly activated by any large event, showing the need to keep full-day scheduling constraints separate from single-window blockers.
